Game Overview

In Sausage Survival Master, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the chaotic kitchen world of Sausage Survival Master. Navigate deadly traps and dodge sizzling hazards in this hilarious survival adventure. With wacky physics and endless one-touch fun, customize your sausage and test your reflexes to become the ultimate survivor. Can you keep your juicy self intact?
